description: Source code for RDKB Power Manager handling power state transitions via system events, including initialization, event handling, and state management.

methods.name: PwrMgr_SetDefaults
methods.description: Initializes power state based on hardware status and sets initial system event.

methods.name: PwrMgr_SyseventSetStr
methods.description: Sets a system event string value.

methods.name: PwrMgr_StateTranstion
methods.description: Handles transition between power states based on system events.

methods.name: PwrMgr_sysevent_handler
methods.description: Thread function that listens for system event notifications and triggers state transitions.

methods.name: PwrMgr_Register_sysevent
methods.description: Registers for system events and initializes system defaults.

methods.name: PwrMgr_Init
methods.description: Initializes system event registration and starts event handler thread.

methods.name: checkIfAlreadyRunning
methods.description: Checks if the power manager process is already running.

methods.name: daemonize
methods.description: Daemonizes the process to run in background.
